name: No? Hear me out...
author: Grattttt
bootlegger: This script features homebrew characters byAlexS & Patters (†)

name: Emissary †
ability: You start knowing 1 of the Demon’s bluffs & an in-play good character.
firstNightReminder: Show an in-play good character token and 1 of the Demon bluffs.

jinxes.reason: The Emissary receives an out-of-play good character instead of a Demon bluff.

flavor: There is a corpse on the road. I could barely recognise them. No papers, no clothing, no face… I fear the worst.

name: Bell-Ringer †
ability: If the number of living evils outnumbers the number of living goods, you are resurrected.
otherNightReminder: If the living evil players outnumber the living good players, the Bell-Ringer is resurrected. :reminder:
flavor: One if by land… thirteen by midnight… though it cost ye yer lives, the town must know! Pull in the ropes lads and hang on the bell!

name: Bandwagon †
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose to become the alignment the Storyteller believes is winning.
flavor: Oh, I was always a fan of… What was it again? Demon worship?

name: Worrywart †
ability: Public and private announcements might be false, even if dead.
flavor: …Yes. I have read ‘The Boy Who Cried Wolf’. Why do you ask?

name: Gargoyle †
ability: If you died by execution this game, you may choose to die or be resurrected at any time.
otherNightReminder: If the Gargoyle has the **HAS ABILITY** reminder token, wake the Gargoyle. Wait for the **THUMBS UP** (to live) or **THUMBS DOWN** (to die) signal. :reminder: Put the Gargoyle to sleep.

jinxes.reason: If the Plague Doctor dies, a Minion who died by execution gains the Gargoyle ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.
